summary: Tank is at the operator's station on the Main Deck, using his finger to trace Neo's path on a monitor. He calls out to Neo, telling him he is almost there and directing him toward a fire escape at the end of an alley.

what_changes.after: Confirming Neo is near the exit point
what_changes.evidence: That's it!  You're almost there! That fire escape at the end of the alley!

event_hint.one_line: Tank guides Neo to his exit point during a pursuit.
